profile.summary: eemikula is a Mid-Level JavaScript developer with specialized expertise in Chart.js, a popular JavaScript library for data visualization. Their contributions demonstrate strong proficiency in vanilla JavaScript (ES6+), defensive programming practices, and frontend-focused development. The developer shows a keen ability to handle edge cases, optimize rendering logic, and maintain backward compatibility in a large-scale library. While contributions are limited to frontend data visualization (DOM manipulation, scaling algorithms), the precision and depth of fixes indicate a solid understanding of JavaScript core concepts. No evidence of backend, TypeScript, or framework-specific (React/Vue) work is present in their contributions.
